items.item: PF-020/PF-038 runner audit: reads/writes outside roots, environment leak, network, child processes, workers, symlink escape, runaway output and wall time are all stopped
tests: PF-020/038 audit: every negative probe is stopped by the local runner, and the omissions are disclosed with the report

items.item: The runner validates roots, cwd, limits, flags and environment before anything starts; node flags that widen permissions or load code are refused
tests: a request cannot widen the boundary: roots, cwd and limits are validated before anything starts

items.item: Symlink escape is refused before a run and fails a run that created one
tests: symlink escape: refused before the run, and a link created during a run that had write access fails it

items.item: Wall clock kills the whole process group, output is capped, abort cancels
tests: limits: wall clock kills the whole group, output is capped, abort cancels

items.item: Network DENY is never silently dropped; omissions are disclosed with every result
tests: network DENY is never silently dropped: a command it cannot isolate is refused when the host has no namespace
a passing run reports PASSED with its output and the runner's omissions
a failing run is FAILED with the exit code; a missing binary is INFRA_ERROR, not a test failure

items.item: S12 runner lane and priority classes in jobs.ts
tests: S12 jobs: runner-lane jobs run in a bounded pool beside the parser slot; priority classes order the queue
S12 jobs: a higher priority class jumps the queue within a lane

items.item: AT-24/AT-57 fencing tokens: a stale holder cannot start, commit or keep its result
tests: AT-24/57 a fencing token that is no longer current refuses the run, and one lost mid-run discards its result
AT-24/57 jobs: a job fenced out by a newer holder of the same key cannot commit and ends CANCELLED

items.item: cancelFeature stops running jobs, ends the request and reports what it could not undo
tests: cancelling a request stops its running job and reports what it could not undo

items.item: CPU, memory and process limits are partial: cpu via prlimit when present, memory bounds the V8 heap only, no container or VM class
items.needs: a container or VM runner profile (defect-isolation.ts docker) behind the same Runner interface
